key.name: movement-enabled
key.description: Master switch to enable or disable moving the toolbar to the active screen.

key.name: movement-speed
key.description: Interval in milliseconds. Lower is faster but uses more CPU.

key.name: animation-style
key.description: Visual effect when toolbar elements teleport (none, fade, slide, pop).

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration of the teleport animation in milliseconds.

key.name: highlight-active
key.description: Apply a background color to the active monitor's panel.

key.name: active-panel-color
key.description: The RGBA string applied to the active panel.

key.name: translucent-inactive
key.description: Make inactive monitor top bars translucent.

key.name: inactive-opacity
key.description: Opacity level for inactive top bars (0.0 to 1.0).

key.name: show-clock
key.description: Show the time on secondary monitors.

key.name: hide-inactive-panels
key.description: Completely hide the top bar on inactive monitors.
